premium.basis: 63% premium to undisturbed price as stated by InterMune board

value_inflection_events.event: Positive top-line data from Phase 3 ASCEND study
Public rumors of a potential transaction cause stock to rise 14.5%

leaked_early.details: Reuters reported buyout interest on 2014-03-07, well over 1 month before announcement

notes: Roche paid a 63% premium to acquire InterMune's lead asset pirfenidone, which had positive Phase 3 data and was nearing US approval, in an all-cash tender offer completed swiftly.
